notes.title: Finding The Game's Identity
notes.content:
[p]Major changes, and now the game will have a stedied progress, i'm introducing the new main mechanic: Credits

Now you buy weapons and can infinetly equip them, so its more of a 'licence to print once per life' kind of deal

Helping in objectives gives you credits, those being: Collecting chips, capturing points and hacking bank machines (those don't give points to your team)

Grinding Rails

New map coating

Customizable game rules (Time, points and starting cash)

FFA winning is determined by whoever reaches the money goal first

I'm eager to get feedback, now I'll focus on new weapons and modules, and expanding this game-mode, before going to the next map or game-mode project
[/p]

notes.title: We're back
notes.content:
[p]New main gamemode: Conquest

Map: City (for now, lots of intentions with this new map)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226676/f599d39170b5d1ade46f2d0fa5ed7fe2df079e3f.png"][/img]
- Collect chips and deliver them, capture objectives or eliminate players to accumulate points for your team

New scoring system, only points counted, not KDA ratios

Disabled map selection for focus on the main gamemode, all will come back but changes in the overall architecture will demand time for adaptation[/p][p][/p][p]Some new equipment, not all fully developed

Full BHop enabled for all characters (Hold Jump to Bhop)

New dash system: Dashing torwards where you're looking

Wall grinding: You slow your fall when hugging a wall, can conserve horizontal speed and while grinding you can always wall-jump

Lots of stuff being made, for now we need testing

Feedback is appreciated, the main focus for now with this gamemode is to try and understand what makes a good objective map, and get the game to feel right. When thats done, we can start getting some new content and polishing what we already have[/p]

notes.title: Last update for awhile
notes.content:
So... i got a job! In a place where I really wanted to work and I'll focus on my carreer for now.

Some weapons and equipments added, not everything is finished from them.

Updates will be even slower now, many ideas but now I have to focus on my actual carrer.

Thanks for everyone who played it for the time being, development WILL continue but considerably slower, this is a passion project.

Any suggestions, send me an email and I'll try to get back to you, thanks!

notes.title: New game design
notes.content:
You can now build your class with equipment and perks, click and drag to equip, click to un-equip.

Previously made characters will not be used anymore, but some models and codes will be used

Graphics are mainly placeholder

Mech mode put to rest for awhile

Cosmetics will come to this newly made design (no transactions (ever))

New map Added: Tranwreck

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45226676/ac320e7450dfe0839b9767dbdcf14b7f6fbec26c.jpg[/img]

There are plans for a total rework of the menus, their UI is insatisfactory and don't reflect the current present characters

#####
More updates to come, if all goes well I'll try making simple bots. I believe we have some good modules, just gotta get some more out there and their equipment icons, also new maps and gamemodes are the intention, but I gotta get better at making them, use blender more for terrain making.
#####

Any feedback and bug reports i'll be glad to hear at : upgradedgamecontact@gmail.com

Thank you!

notes.title: Mech melee and going forward
notes.content:
New Mech Melee ('Q' default, same as 'sub-skill')

New animations for melee and slightly remade torso models

New shoulder weapon for mechs, the double barrel shotgun

New map for mechs

Removed boosters from torso, unique booster models will come

Less focus on the 'default' mode for now, feeling like remaking all of it with my new experience making mechs and I think I can make it way better and fun in the future, by having you assemble your android as well

More to come, mainly in mech content for now, but I will remake the humanoid characters and game

Maps are simple but I need to get my own idea on how to make them better, for now they are usable, minimum viable product, but they can be great, I'm just not ready yet

Hope you have fun and I'll answer any suggestions or feedback.

notes.title: Small fixes - Mechs and General
notes.content:
An issue with networking packets has been resolved, still being investigated for more returns. If successfull, the game should run smoother now.

Mech horn selectable on spawning, 'V' on keyboard to use, not mappable yet

New sounds for dashing and boosting

Boosting horizontally (SHIFT) or vertically (JUMP) now produces heat based on the boost power

Dashing changed, now sets your speed on a given direction based on your dash power, no longer having a 'slow down' animation

Global health and max heat nerfs, mechs were too tanky and mobile, not needing thinking through, balancing is being studied

Next there will be more parts, stepping sounds, weapons, and a proper map is being studied.

Feedback is appreciated, thanks for listening.

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
Mech colors now selectable

Mech UI light redesiign, improovement will happen

Working on new parts and a proper Map for mech combat

Feedback is appreciated!

notes.title: Mecha
notes.content:
We got mechas now or 'AC at home' as i'd like to call.

At the game lobby, there is a 'Test Zone (Mecha FFA)' Map that you can choose to play it.

- For now there are few parts, 2 weapons and 2 shoulder weapons
- Melee is intended in the future
- Heads are only cosmetic
- There is only one coolant type with a passive reduction in heat

Your character is red but i'm working on color selection.

More game-modes are intended for the mecha mode, maybe even a crossover with the normal 'android' mode.

I'm pushing this update for testing purposes, mainly to see if its actually fun to play, feedback is always appreciated.

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
Occluder in some maps resulting in meshes not rendering correctly, hopefully solved

Outsider blink reworked, requires 2 presses, launches the blink symbol then you blink to it - Previous model was resulting in the character getting stuck in the map too often

Analysing sudden frame-drops/stutter, implemented forced 60fps cap for the game, can be changed later to be user-controlled.

Any sugestions or feedback I'll be happy to hear!

notes.title: Small fixes
notes.content:
Colony (Map) - altered colors, hopefully improving player visibility

Outside - Some 'blink' issues patched, you could blink outside the map, fixed for the moment

Fullscreen mode in the Options Menu

2 new game-modes being worked on, new map being produced


Feedback and sugestions, I'll be happy to hear/answer!

notes.title: New Game Mode and Map on test branch
notes.content:
Map - Corners
Game mode: Scavenge, collect chips to earn score for your team, score is only counted when delivered to a delivery zone, those change with time, you drop your chips on death so anyone can collect.

Chip respawn time (in-map): 30 seconds
Zone change time: 60 seconds
